feed.title: Equifax gets preliminary approval for $100M FCRA settlement
feed.summary: Equifax has received preliminary approval for a $100 million settlement regarding a 2022 coding error that miscalculated credit scores for approximately 4 million consumers. This settlement, the largest in Fair Credit Reporting Act history, addresses a three-week period where inaccurate scores led to potential credit denials or higher interest rates. A final fairness hearing is scheduled for January 22, 2027, after which payments to affected class members will commence.

feed.title: Regional Demo at Elbit Systems in Shenstone
feed.summary: The Palestine Solidarity Campaign is organizing a regional demonstration in Shenstone, Staffordshire, against Elbit Systems' drone factory, UAV Engines. The protest, supported by various groups including West Midlands PSC and Campaign Against Arms Trade, is in response to Elbit Systems allegedly supplying Israel with weaponry for its actions in the Gaza Strip and West Bank. The event is scheduled for August 22, 2026, from 1:00 pm to 3:00 pm, and attendees will meet near Shenstone Train Station.

feed.title: East West Bancorp Announces Fall 2026 Conference Participation
feed.summary: East West Bancorp, Inc. announced that its management will participate in several investor conferences in the fall of 2026. CFO Christopher Del Moral-Niles will speak at the Barclays Global Financial Services Conference in September and will also meet with investors at the Jefferies Boston Bank Conference and the BankAnalysts Association of Boston Conference in November to discuss the company's business, performance, and strategy. feed.title: Enova (NYSE: ENVA) issues $301M consumer loan-backed notes
feed.summary: Enova International, Inc.'s indirect subsidiary, NetCredit Combined Receivables B, LLC, issued $300.886 million in asset-backed notes on August 21, 2026, backed by approximately $316.72 million of unsecured consumer installment loans. These notes, structured into Class A, B, and C with fixed coupons, mature on September 20, 2032, and were privately offered to qualified institutional buyers and non-U.S. persons. The proceeds will be used to purchase securitized receivables, fund a reserve, and cover transaction fees, with Enova not guaranteeing the obligations.

feed.title: Equinix expands Colombia data center, lifts investment to US$73mn

The company aims to support the accelerating digital transformation needs of organizations in the Andean region.

feed.title: ConocoPhillips names CFO Andy O'Brien as new CEO, tasked with completing Alaska's Willow oil project and delivering $7 billion cash flow target by 2029
feed.summary: ConocoPhillips has appointed CFO Andy O'Brien as its new CEO, effective September 1, succeeding Ryan Lance, who will become executive chairman. O'Brien inherits the challenging goal of achieving a $7 billion free cash flow target by 2029, largely dependent on the completion of the Willow oil project in Alaska, which has seen cost increases and faces significant execution risks. Despite the company's recent share underperformance and internal cost-cutting measures, O'Brien has affirmed his commitment to the existing strategic plan.

This revised outlook, which projects lower revenue and earnings compared to previous analyst expectations, puts pressure on the company's near-term earnings story.

feed.title: Delta Air Lines Cuts Las Vegas Routes to Focus on Premium Travelers

This strategic shift comes as visitor volume to Las Vegas declined and aims to mitigate rising fuel costs by focusing on high-paying passengers. Despite these route adjustments, analysts like Goldman Sachs and Argus maintain a "Buy" rating on DAL stock, citing its strong loyalty program and robust international network.

feed.title: DIVO ETF's higher fees and capped gains lead to lower net returns than S&P 500 over 5 years.
feed.summary: The Amplify CWP Enhanced Dividend Income ETF (DIVO) has underperformed the S&P 500 over five years due to its 0.56% fee and covered call strategy, which caps upside gains and incurs ordinary income tax on option premiums. For a $500,000 investment, fees alone cost about $2,800 annually. Investors are encouraged to consider cheaper alternatives like SCHD and VYM for broader dividend exposure, or JEPI for a similar option-income strategy at a lower cost, weighing whether DIVO's smoother ride justifies its higher fees and tax complexity.

feed.title: SCE Crews Head to Hawaii to Restore Power
feed.summary: Southern California Edison (SCE) crews are deploying to Hawaii Island to assist Hawaiian Electric in restoring power after Hurricane Lala caused extensive damage. A 63-person team, including distribution and transmission crews, will repair damaged power lines, especially in remote, forested areas of the Big Island. This marks the first time Hawaiian Electric has requested aid from continental U.S. crews for storm restoration.
